versionTitle: 1.3.0-Diamond+ (1,500-Book Digital Library, Client-Server DB, Silent Launchers & Native MSI/DMG/PKG)
changelog:
• 📚 Complete 1,500-Book Digital Materia Medica Library: All 1,500 classical, pharmacopoeial, and indigenous CCRH volumes populated with browsable left-pane bookshelf, instant click-to-read sections, and SQLite FTS5 BM25 search.
• 🌐 True Client-Server Workstation Separation: Dedicated Server Host (authenticated HTTP/JSON SQLite WAL RPC + Image Vault on port 45825 + LAN UDP Beacon on 45824) and true Client Terminal mode without creating isolated local user_clinic.db files.
• 🔇 Zero-Terminal Desktop Launch: Native self-contained GUI launchers (Windows OpenHomeo.exe / hidden VBS javaw.exe, macOS OpenHomeo.app, Linux Desktop entry Terminal=false) with zero console windows opening on startup.
• 🔧 Hardened Windows & Unix Installers + Uninstaller: Fixed PowerShell Java 21 LTS detection on stderr, added native .msi / .dmg / .pkg / distro-independent Linux .tar.gz packaging, and bundled clean Uninstallers preserving patient data.
• 🛡️ Fail-Safe Atomic OTA Engine: SemVer detection from runtime metadata, SHA-256 verification before payload swap, rollback snapshots, and detached PID-waiting updater.
